scope: Manual source-bound fit, socket-load-path and manufacturing geometry review. Installed native solids, sampled rigid assembly poses, source-derived continuous loading bounds and offline emitted paths have separate scopes. No physical acceptance or new recurring check is introduced.

construction.customer_service: Only complete prepared pumps are replaced; wet fittings, tube links, keepers, fixtures and magnets remain seated.
construction.envelope_scope: Decoded current enclosure-box dimensions. This local review is not an all-appliance clearance or shipping qualification.

native_fit_correspondence.scope: Current dry parts subtract stock from the directly checked parts without changing poses, so those exact intersection and entry clearances remain valid. Current socket/key reactions, washer backing, guide walls and actual print faces are separately read below. Separate high pogo stock and WAGO wells belong to the current full appliance reading.

hardware_source_correspondence.scope: The exact source/candidate cutter solids have zero symmetric difference at all four stations. These three complete function ASTs remain identical in the current source; the separate guide-tail subtraction has its own current native reading.

installed_fit.obstacles: Production-order fixed wall/guides/trays/floor/stops, all 8 purchased pump-link valves/coils, all 20 actual dock parts including neighbors/keepers, fixed magnets and potting. Separate retained-envelope and whole-appliance checks keep their own scope.

inner_guide_open_continuation.scope: The complete four-mm guide band retains all three full 3 mm cardinal walls. The unused upper/inboard continuation is open through the identified material-line witness. The lower confinement and broad inboard slab stay continuous. This is not an all-section minimum or physical strength reading.

washer_support.fore_and_inner_aft: 28.206 mm² standard annulus after the intentional crowned 3.5 mm shaft opening; all actual contact has complete 3 mm backing.

outer_aft.scope: Balanced partial washer land with full 3 mm beneath the actual patch. The head footprint is partly unsupported; no full-annulus, torque or clamp-strength claim.

signed_diagonal_clearance_budget.axis_convention: a is the junction-lower outward axis; the return-input axis is exactly −a. Separation moves the junction in −a and the return in +a. Junction-floor take-up in +a shortens the span.
signed_diagonal_clearance_budget.limit: The remaining 0.190 mm must contain manufacturing variation, temperature and loaded TPU movement. It is not a measured deformation allowance or lifetime result. At 0.50 mm total clearance at least 5.50 mm seal engagement remains.

order: Seat aft valves/coils while front-top is loose.
Bench-assemble empty cradle/cover pairs, park covers 6.25 mm in their local outward coordinate and raise pairs through the underside.
Load each connected fore-valve/upper-link/junction group toward −Y.
Slide keepers down and tighten front-driven screws with cartridge absent.
Raise free returns 6.5 mm onto the actual short valve tails through open cradles.
Close covers, locally fold the TPU heads and fit shared M3×12 locks.

finite_pose_reading.scope: The coherent 92-pose reading covers paired raises, fore-group loading, return raises and closure. Final changed-stock checks include the actual current 20 closure poses, open loading envelopes and source halfspaces at the forward inner host. Own wet closure uses bare bodies; local TPU heads are folded separately. These are not 92 continuous or physical assembly proofs.

factory_assembly.continuous_bounds: Source primitive loading bounds contain the complete 50 mm fore-group stroke and 6.5 mm return lift. Analytical cuff/port sweeps and arm silhouettes define complementary 6.25 mm closure and 26 mm empty-pair bench-entry pockets. Parked fingers begin beyond key shanks; final inner host/base Y/Z halfspaces preserve underside entry. Finite samples alone establish none of those continuous bounds.

shared_driver.scope: Complete declared blade/handle approach, all 8 stacks and actual neighboring parts clear with front-top loose/cartridge absent. Not a measured on-hand tool, hand-clearance, tightening-torque or physical assembly result.

front_keeper.cartridge_scope: Native cartridge-back correspondence and sampled 0–100 mm withdrawal clear. Final whole-appliance geometry/publication is a separate reading; no physical fit acceptance.

manufacturing.PETGF_process: Twelve manufacturing meshes are already in print pose; identity turns, six walls and 100% object infill, 0.20 mm first and 0.24 mm body layers. Shared localized cooling uses ordinary and auxiliary fans at 0%, qualifying bridge/overhang cooling at 70% with the 50% unsupported-width threshold. No printer launch.

current_inner_base_print_face_scope.scope: The inner-base open cleanup has its own current posed native-normal reading. Its cutter starts inward of localW−6.425, away from the common flat back; the saved bed footprint scope remains separate.

manufacturing.native_face_scope: All planar faces read exactly; curved native normals sampled at tessellation centroids, bed 0.002 mm excluded. No native downward faces below 45 degrees were found. Each inner cradle begins on two bed components joined above by the same solid. This is not emitted bead adhesion/removal or physical print acceptance.
manufacturing.wet_scope: Eight editable one-object native Siraya Tech Flex TPU85A Clear projects; actual support/travel/key-deposition readings and native estimates. No printer contacted or physical result.

named_sections.outer_junction_lower_ledge: 42.7665 mm² total contact; conservative 39.8552 mm² full 3 mm axial backing. The remaining throat-edge taper is not assigned uniform 3 mm thickness.
named_sections.output_head_corner: The valve-port clearance leaves a named 2–3 mm corner while retaining the separately reported complete 3 mm head-bearing patch.
named_sections.aft_backstrip: Broad 2.90 mm section beside sliding-arm pocket; hard lock tabs retain 3 mm beneath actual bearing patches.

limits: No seal, pressure, extraction-force, repeated-swap, cleaning, food-contact, physical key recovery or lifetime acceptance exists for this complete dock.
Geometry/settings do not establish PETGF capacity, TPU creep, seal recovery or bore cleanliness. The remaining tolerance budget is not a measured load allowance.
See pressure-retention-review.json for actual single-channel pressure paths and failed-pump vent limits. TimedDry/PWM success does not establish both ports depressurized.
canonical_export_scope: Twenty current station-specific manufacturing STEP/STLs in their authored print poses, generated from the bound source. Native installed proof outputs above retain their own coordinate frames and identities.

box_input_equivalence.scope: The complete dock plate and outer bounds are exact. Nine other coordinates move by at most 1e-7 mm; the document comparator accepts up to 1e-6 mm of native coordinate jitter. Native installed and manufacturing artifact identities remain as separately recorded; no assertion of complete raw Box byte identity is made.

canonical_clearance_precision_reading.disposition: The four literal card rows remain unchanged. Their mesh distances are false positives relative to the nominal 1 mm native interface: each actual exported BRep gap is 1 mm within native arithmetic precision and exactly matches the reviewed candidate. Independently tessellated curved valve/relief surfaces account for the approximately 0.003 mm difference, inside the existing reader's approximately twice-0.02 mm chord bound. This manual reading changes no geometry, global floor or exemption and establishes no physical fit margin.
